business_problem: Fragmented systems, workbook-driven reporting, and inconsistent definitions kept planners and executives from getting fast, trusted answers, making it hard to keep pace with rapid retail decisions and emerging AI demand.
solution_summary: Under Armour standardized analytics and AI on Snowflake so product, sales, inventory, supply-chain, and planning data could support daily reporting and conversational AI without moving data between tools. Operational and commercial data now land on one Snowflake platform that acts as the single source of truth for analytics, business intelligence, and the golden reports that anchor trusted metrics. Secure Data Sharing and Data Clean Rooms extend that foundation, while Snowflake CoWork gives knowledge workers a conversational interface to ask questions against approved data and Snowflake CoCo helps developers build faster. The same architecture powers agentic workflows such as an internal help desk and speeds onboarding by letting new employees learn processes through AI. By combining governance, live shared data, and user-facing AI on one platform, Under Armour turned reporting into daily decision support and made natural-language access practical across the enterprise.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Acts as the central platform for governed retail, planning, and analytics data used across the enterprise.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Extends trusted Snowflake data to collaborators without moving or duplicating the underlying datasets.

solution_components.name: Data Clean Rooms
solution_components.role: Provides governed collaboration patterns for sensitive data while preserving trust and control.

solution_components.name: Snowflake CoWork
solution_components.role: Lets knowledge workers ask natural-language questions against governed data and receive actionable answers quickly.

solution_components.name: Snowflake CoCo
solution_components.role: Supports developers and agentic workflows that build, diagnose, and extend AI-enabled data experiences faster.

data_flow: Inventory, supply-chain, demand-planning, sales, and product data are centralized in Snowflake and anchored to trusted golden reports. Secure Data Sharing and Data Clean Rooms extend that governed foundation, while CoWork and CoCo turn the same approved data into conversational answers, developer assistance, and agentic workflows.
business_outcome: Under Armour turned product-margin reporting from a week-long monthly exercise into an automated daily process, delivers leadership reporting by morning instead of after days of manual work, and uses conversational AI to speed onboarding and operational decisions.
architecture_clues: AI-generated answers are anchored to golden reports so natural-language insights start from trusted business definitions.
The team spent five years building observability, governance, and reliable data models before scaling conversational AI.
Under Armour emphasizes not moving data, using Snowflake to combine analytics, collaboration, and AI on one platform.
evidence_quotes: Snowflake has provided us with a single source of truth for analytics, AI and business intelligence.
Snowflake CoWork has been a game changer for us to truly enable our end users with conversational AI in a controlled manner.
